notes_for_editor: Thin record. Evidence is a list entry plus one passing sentence in a 2023 WRAL article about a north Raleigh tower; the article gives no date, builder, height or fate for the Lowes Grove tower. Story is kept short and says what is missing only where the guide allows (site today). Consider holding publication until a Durham or NC Forest Service source is found. Not yet checked: Durham County Library NC Collection subject file 'Lowe's Grove' (archive.durhamcountylibrary.org, archival_objects/5508; fetch returned no text), and Peter J. Barr's 2021 book, named in a search result but not read. The WRAL article gives no location for its Lowes Grove, so the link to the Durham community (tnlandforms list, Open Durham page) is an assumption; the story now says the article gives no location. Fact-check 2026-10-21: the 2023 date, the newspaper attribution, the Durham County entry and the NCDCR attribution now have supporting quotes.
